    How this site works

    Every tool here is a single lightweight page. The maths runs in your own browser, so nothing you type is uploaded, logged or stored — there is no account, no cookie banner and no tracking pixel.

    We check every calculator against worked examples before it goes live, and the pages are plain HTML so they load fast even on a weak mobile connection. If something ever gives a wrong result, we want to know about it.
